newsitem.title: USA: Molten Metal says to cut 77 jobs.
newsitem.headline: Molten Metal says to cut 77 jobs.

text.p: Molten Metal Technology Inc said Wednesday it will cut 77 jobs through a corporate restructuring program.
The company said the jobs are mainly at its research and development facility in Fall River, Mass. and at the corporate headquarters in Waltham, Mass.
The company said the design and development group will be reorganized after the job cuts so that many of its remaining positions support plant operations.
In addition, the company said it has reorganized its sales and marketing force from two internal business units to a single group.

The company said it expects to add about 60 more full-time employees once it finishes negotiations with Lockheed Martin Corp to restructure M4 Environmental LP, the limited partnership between Molten Metal Technology and Lockheed Martin Corporation.
The company said it expects to complete the M4 restructuring by the end of this month.
Following this restructuring and the hiring of M4 employees, Molten Metal Technology will have a full-time employee base of about 510 people.
